assets.prompt: ELITEWAKE realistic animal modeling reference. A realistic high-domed tortoise with tan polygonal scutes, dark seams, concentric growth rings centered in each polygon and varied plate tones. A single row of FIVE vertebral scutes down the spine, FOUR costal plates on each side, approximately ELEVEN marginal plates around each side of rim. Grey scaly columnar legs and wrinkled neck. Two matching modeling views on one sheet: direct TOP view showing the whole exact scute layout, and true SIDE view showing dome height. No stripes across shell, no banded generic texture.  Plain light studio background, even neutral illumination, full animal visible in every panel, no scenery, water, plants, people, gear, labels, text or watermark. High anatomical clarity.
